title: Evaluator calibration case
description: One JSON object per line of a data/evaluator-calibration/*.jsonl file: a turn as this repo's Foundry evaluators see it, with the verdict each should give. evals/calibrate_evaluators.py has the evaluators judge every case and lists the verdicts that differ. Messages use the shape of a stored response's history: content parts such as input_text, output_text, tool_call and tool_result. Validate with scripts/validate_eval_jsonl.py.

case.description: The case's id, unique across the files.

expect.description: The verdict each of this repo's evaluators should give. Evaluators not listed aren't checked on this case.

notes.description: What the case tests and why it should get its verdicts.

query.description: What the evaluators see before the judged turn: the agent's instructions as a system message, the earlier turns with their tool calls and results, then the user's message.

response.description: The judged turn: its tool calls and results, then the reply.
